title: Core normalized comparison data
statement: For an isomorphism of schemes and the recorded closed structures and tensor models, there exists a normalized Comparison containing the chain, derived, tensor, and all representative normalization fields.

proof.text: Obtain the Hom-side core data and the pure-normalized tensor-chain data from their existing component theorems. Apply the corrected comparison_core_tensor_model_exists to that tensor data to choose its normalized derived tensor comparison. Assemble Comparison using the same chain, projection, derived Hom, and pure-tensor fields, the newly chosen tensor comparison, and its proved K-flat representative model. Every field and the theorem statement are unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 2; choose the normalized derived tensor together with its model equation.
